sections.label: The prompt, typed into Codex in Hydrogen
sections.text: This prompt asks Codex to recreate Aske's point two: run the ADD command from a script, so Fusion's library picker blocks it.

sections.label: Codex opens the board and runs ADD from a script
sections.text: Codex opens the board in Fusion, then runs ADD from a script.

sections.label: Fusion's modal picker pops up, and the script is blocked
sections.text: And there it is: Fusion's modal library picker pops up over your work, and the script is stuck until someone closes it.

sections.label: The bridge reads the dialog through UI Automation
sections.text: The bridge reads the dialog through Windows UI Automation: its title, its text, and all four buttons.

sections.label: Cancelled in the background, no focus stolen
sections.text: Then it presses Cancel in the background, with no mouse and no focus change, and the script carries on.

sections.label: Codex reports back
sections.text: Codex reports back: the script resumed, and Fusion is responsive again, with no blocking dialogs.
